notes:
dashy 0.8.2

A fix for the Windows app not opening.

On Windows, dashy could open its small control window and then never show a
page. The browser opened on an address nothing was answering. The Windows build
has no console window, and the web server failed while it set up its logging
because there was nowhere to write to. dashy now writes that output to a log
file, %APPDATA%\dashy\dashy.log, so the server starts. The file holds the most
recent run only and is replaced each time dashy starts.

Upgrading needs no manual step and there are no new schema migrations.

Known and shipping unfixed, for the sixth release running: the Windows build
bundles keyring without its backends, so provider credentials fall back to
dashy's own file store rather than Credential Manager. Nothing is lost and the
fallback is the designed one.
